notes.title: Closed Beta Test Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes


Construction interval of cubes reduced.
Attack range of the shovel increased from 200 to 300.
Resource drop platforms added: every 60 seconds in any mode except classic, a resource pack appears on one of two platforms (selected randomly), adding 250 resources to each team member who captures the resource pack. In classic mode - 500 resources.
Health segment increased to 200 points.

Kamenev

Cannon: main attack projectile's range and speed, ballistics overhauled, now the grenade launcher attacks in a straight trajectory at medium distance.
Speed up to 6000.
Explosion radius of the grenade launcher's grenade increased to 250.
Health increased to 1800.

Health increased to 2200.
Ability recharge increased from 5 to 8 seconds.

Rocket launcher: recharge decreased from 2.7 to 2 seconds.
Armor increased from 700 to 800.

Projectile range and ballistics improved.

Impulse from alternative attack increased.

Armor increased from 1700 to 1800.

Eliza Ray, Аgent X

Ironclads

Mortars
The damage to units has been increased from 400 to 500.

DaGamma

The Q ability has been reworked: when activated, it increases DaGamma and her allies' fire rate by 20% within a 400 radius and also cancels reload time by 3 seconds.
Reload time of the ability is 15 seconds.
The weapon has been reworked: now the rifle shoots projectiles with limited lifespan. Upon hitting an obstacle, the projectiles explode in a small radius (300) and deal 350 damage.

UI

F1 prompts menu added
Alternate attack icons added
Missing icons added to kill feed
Effective and maximum range identification added
Enemies within the effective range of the weapon are highlighted in red, and within the maximum range are highlighted in yellow
The player can now stay on the death screen without switching to other player cameras.

New feature


Rookie Event

The Rookie event is available only for new players who start the game for the first time and will consist of 12 matches, with the goal to get all new players together in one match.

In the event that there are not enough players to start a Rookie match, then the first available NON rookie players can backfill should they wish to. *However, the rewards are given only to NEW players starting the game for the first time. If you are an existing player joining the Rookie Event, then this is your time to shine as a Blockhead and help new players to understand how to play.

The Battlepass has 12 steps for each match. Players get rewards only for finished matches whether they win or lose.

Rewards for the event:

Razer's unique weapon skin ("Boy Scout")
Profile tokens.
Profile badges.
“Ace of Spades” keychain.
Unique skin Razer “Boy Scout”
Boosters.
